rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Download {
    meta:
        description = "Detects download of common Cobalt Strike beacon payloads"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_header = "MZ" at 0
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" ascii
        $c2_uri = "http://" or "https://" within 200
    condition:
        $beacon_header and $http_get and $c2_uri and filesize < 500KB
}

arguments.summary: A critical data exfiltration attempt was detected and thwarted on 2026-04-09. The service account 'svc-sql-prod' was compromised and used to execute a full mysqldump of the 'customer_records' database (4.2M rows, 1.8GB). The dump file was staged in /tmp and an outbound SCP transfer to external IP 203.0.113.88 was initiated but blocked by the firewall. The incident originated from a phishing compromise of user 'jsmith' on host WS-FIN-042, leading to Cobalt Strike beaconing, lateral movement, and privilege escalation to the service account. All active sessions and keys for 'svc-sql-prod' have been revoked, and the database server has been remediated. No data was exfiltrated.

        description = "Detects Outlook spawning PowerShell with common obfuscation flags"

        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1566.001, T1059.001"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $powershell = "powershell.exe" nocase

        $w_hidden = "-w hidden" nocase
        $encoded = "-encodedcommand" nocase

        all of ($outlook*) and all of ($powershell*) and ($nop or $w_hidden) and $encoded
}
